title: Exclude the noisy term
hook: The right topic appears in both notes and newsletters.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a minus sign before a word excludes the messages that contain it, which removes noise such as newsletters from a topic search

misconception: Adding a word to a search can only narrow it by requiring that word too.
objective: Use exclusion to remove an explicitly unwanted term.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: The right topic appears in both notes and newsletters. Which query removes newsletter matches? Correct option: Topic minus newsletter. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
